markup.title: Your markup
markup.intro: What your customers pay on top of your cost price. It affects one thing only: the final price. Your cost price is set in your agreement with us — if it changes, final prices follow automatically without you touching this number.
markup.label: Markup in percent
markup.range: Must be between 0 and 500. Below 0 you would be selling at a loss.
markup.example: A typical promo video — 20 seconds, four animated scenes with voiceover:
markup.zero: At 0 % you sell at cost. You earn nothing on productions — which can be deliberate if you make your money elsewhere.
markup.receipt: ✅ Saved. New prices apply from your next production — anything already produced keeps the price it ran at.
markup.why: We state the markup in percent, not kroner, because the cost price can change. The markup then follows along instead of becoming an amount that quietly goes wrong. What you have actually earned is on the

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.intro: What your customers used in the period, and how much goes to you. Settlement follows usage — credits bought but not yet used don't count.
settlement.none: No usage recorded in this period.
settlement.vat: Figures exclude VAT. Credits bought in advance stay as unused balance until they are actually spent — so revenue here can be lower than what was purchased in the period.
settlement.collectedHint: Card payments we have received on your customers' behalf
settlement.discountFactorHint: Credit packages include a volume discount, so cash received is lower than the spending power granted. Your share is adjusted by the same ratio.
settlement.dueHint: This is what we pay out at the monthly settlement
settlement.noCustomers: No customers with activity this period.

partners.title: Partners
partners.intro: {name}'s direct sub-tiers — the markup they take from their own customers, the licence fee from the partner agreement, and their brand (name, logo and colours on their own domain).
partners.none: No partners under this tier yet.
partners.noneWho: You are seeing this as {slug}. The partner list follows the domain you are signed in on — on the wrong address, you see the wrong tier.
partners.infraSub: The platform's 3 % of voice and face revenue across ALL banks in the tree — rights handling, logging and payout.
partners.infraNone: No asset revenue in the tree this month yet.
partners.ourMarkupHint: Our margin. Sets the cost price {name} is invoiced — and nothing else. 100 % = today's level.
partners.theirMarkupWarn: You are overriding {name}'s own number. They will see the change as their own.
partners.theirMarkupHint: Decides what the end customer pays: cost price × (1 + markup/100). This is the partner's decision — they set it themselves under «Markup».
partners.brandCardHint: Shown under the name on the end card customers get in exchange for a discount. Write it the way someone watching a video should read it — no https:// Leave empty for no address.
partners.saved: Partner saved — visible on their domain within a minute.
partners.numberError: Markup and licence fee must be numbers.

creditsPage.title: Credits
creditsPage.intro: Buy credits up front — every production draws from your balance, and the cost meter always shows whether you are covered.
creditsPage.noAccount: No prepaid account yet — it is created automatically on your first purchase.
creditsPage.footConsumer: Card payment. Credits never expire. The cost meter in the editor always shows what a production will draw from your balance — and what you make yourself (your own images, your own voice, your own video) is free.
creditsPage.footPro: Card payment. The rate improves with the size of the purchase — the best rate is 1 credit = 0.10 kr. The cost meter in the editor always shows what a production will draw from your balance.
creditsPage.thanks: Thank you! Payment received — your balance updates in a few seconds.
